description: HydroGIS Viewer is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory | National Hydropower Asset Assessment Program. The HydroGIS Viewer is a geographic information system (GIS) web map service that allows registered users to view select information from the National Hydropower Asset Assessment Program (NHAAP). Available maps show geospatial distribution and characterizations of existing hydropower plants, dams, and generators; environmental mitigation layers; streamflow and climate time series information; and geographic reference layers. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Water Quality. Assets: Energy and Utilities. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
